summary: The main article describes a cooperative photoredox and N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) catalysis for the C-H aroylation of allenes. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope schemes for di- and trisubstituted allenes, and detailed mechanistic studies including cyclic voltammetry and Stern-Volmer quenching.
